svg.title: A chain of shade islands
svg.desc: Three small rigid parasols share shade along the queue; one island is seat-free for wheels.. Bus stop concept with perspective and accessible site plan.
svg.text: Three small rigid parasols share shade along the queue; one island is seat-free for wheels.
fixed metal hoods / no opening mechanism
KEEP CLEAR · continuous 1.8 m walking route
Shade is distributed fairly along the line, but gaps remain and three separate posts mean more foundations.
